title: Relic Researcher Workbench — Subject Overview
description: Data contract for the Subject Overview page (PR27C). subject_id and experiment_id are required; absence of active_gumi_instance triggers BLOCKED_MISSING_GUMI_INSTANCE.

subject_id.description: Unique subject identifier. Required; page is inaccessible without it.

consent_status.description: Current consent state for this subject.

active_condition.description: Experimental condition the subject is assigned to.

active_gumi_instance.description: Name/id of the active Gumi instance. Null triggers BLOCKED_MISSING_GUMI_INSTANCE degraded state.

provisioned.description: Whether the Hermes profile is provisioned and active.

hermes_home.description: Filesystem path to the Hermes profile directory.

hermes_profile_status.description: Active Hermes profile status. Must be visible on the page.

last_user_interaction.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent user-initiated interaction.

last_gumi_initiative.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent proactive Gumi initiative.

last_relic_extraction.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent Relic memory extraction.

last_synthesis.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent synthesis run.

last_correction.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent researcher correction.

active_cron_modes.description: List of currently active cron mode identifiers for this subject.

flag_count.description: Total number of active risk flags.

flags.description: List of active risk flag identifiers.

risk_summary.description: Aggregated risk summary for this subject.

pending_review_count.description: Number of inference items pending researcher review.

pause_all.description: Suspend all Gumi output and ingestion for this subject.

pause_relic_ingestion.description: Suspend Relic memory extraction for this subject.

pause_state.description: Subject-scoped pause flags. Each flag is independently toggleable. Pause actions must not affect other subjects (BLOCKED_PAUSE_NOT_SUBJECT_SCOPED).
